name: turul-mcp-skills
description: Skills and tools for building MCP servers and clients with the Turul MCP Framework (Rust), targeting MCP 2026-07-28 with frozen 2025-11-25 opt-in coverage. Guides tool creation, resource/prompt patterns, output schemas, client patterns (bilingual negotiation), middleware, error handling, the 2026-07-28 Tasks extension, Lambda deployment, testing, MRTR elicitation, storage backend selection, authentication/authorization (OAuth 2.1 RS, JWT, API key), authorization server patterns (demo PKCE, JWKS, DCR/CIMD), project scaffolding, and validation.
